main_question: Can new within-study, within-species trait-rate comparisons separate historical climatic association from modern climate, assay design and group differences?
unit: A new block containing two rate-comparison records of the same species and study, same exact trait and measurement procedure, matched on current-climate and methodological controls but contrasting in historical exposure. A record is not necessarily one population or one individual.
priority_rule: Prioritize genuinely new within-study/species geographic contrasts, not more traits/effect rows at the same old locations. Do not rank sources using observed phenotype-rate signs or significance.
independence_review: Shared source individuals, populations, assay batches, species or studies may correlate errors. Independent-block planning is hypothetical, not presumed by counting records.
claim_limits: Common garden or source Genetic classification is not evidence of increased fitness.
Field phenotypic difference is not a within-genotype plasticity reaction norm.
Present collection sites are not demonstrated LGM occupancy.
Species diversification requires a separate dated-lineage/reproductive-isolation outcome.
